corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez grammar and the Amharic gloss on L10 ('የዳነው ምን ጊዜ ነው አላቸው') confirm 'ወይቤሎሙ አየ [ጊዜ ሐይወ]' ('and he said to them: at what [time did he recover]'). Visually the glyphs are ሎ and አ.
Biblical reference to the feasts in Leviticus (ዘሌዋውያን) is chapter 23:5 (፳፫ ፭), as Leviticus only has 27 chapters. Visually the second numeral is ፫.
Andemta glosses the Ge'ez enclitic 'ዝ' from 'ወእምድኅረዝ' ('ዝ ሲናገረው የመጣው ነው'). Visually the character has the two vertical strokes of ዝ.
Joined across the line wrap from L22 ('ነበ↵ረ'), the verb is 1st-order 'ነበረ'. Visually the first glyph on L23 is ረ without a top-left notch.
The standard Amharic word for paralyzed/withered is 'ልምሾ'. Visually the character has the 7th-order top loop of ሾ rather than the side stroke of ሹ.
